paper.authors: Davide Cazzaro and David Franz Koza and David Pisinger
paper.title: Combined Layout and Cable Optimization of Offshore Wind Farms

paper_linked_public_asset_candidates.use: all ten paper-native sites, geometry, fixed turbines, wind and turbine curves
paper identity and public abstract; no executable source
visibility graph, balanced radial Sweep, exact small strings, Swap and cable set

completion_decisions: Consume the official ten-site archive byte-for-byte and use availablePositions.txt as the binary decision set.
Use paper Eqs. 1-6 and 20-30 for joint NPV, layout, cable flow, capacity, balance and crossing semantics.
Use the paper-cited predecessor for visibility routing, the 240/336 EUR/m capacity-4/6 cable set, balanced Sweep and exact small strings.
Place one fixed substation at each zone candidate centroid because the authors' manually placed coordinates are unpublished.
Assign separable lateral lanes to the planar rooted-path forest when visibility routes share mandatory obstacle corridors because lane widths and offset costs are unpublished.
Allocate published low-density site totals among zones proportionally to high-density quotas by largest remainder.
Use ten deterministic Sweep rotations and exact subset dynamic programming for every capacity-six string.
Use same-lineage 3D/5D/8D radii, 128 one-opt and 16-by-16 two-opt candidates for unpublished neighborhood controls.
Expose literal 10/24-hour runs and freeze 860/2064 complete VNS cycles for reproducible 25-seed formal experiments.
Exclude sequential and other paper comparison baselines from target reproduction.
missing_information: author source and original random states
lateral cable lane widths and offset costs in shared obstacle corridors
root-string placement rule and Sweep multistart count
string randomization and all Swap schedules
candidate radii, caps, shake size and VNS schedule

paper_source_conflicts: Paper Table 1 reports total info.json Points as available positions, although the official availablePositions.txt decision files exclude fixed turbines.
Site A official README reports high-density quotas 26/8, while info.json areas and the paper total 40 imply 26/14.

scope.claim_boundary: academic flexible paper/data reconstruction of the target combined heuristic and all twenty paper cases; not author code unpublished manual substations Gurobi bitstream original random stream or numerical replay

decision_variables.resolution: binary candidate-position selection plus balanced radial cable arcs and types

objective_and_direction.resolution: maximize annual AEP times 450 EUR/MWh lifetime factor minus official foundation and cable costs

constraints_and_repair.resolution: exact zone cardinality, 1200 m spacing, balanced capacity-six radial strings, visibility-routed obstacle avoidance and declared separable corridor lanes yielding a planar no-crossing embedding

encoding_and_decoder.resolution: sorted official candidate indices decoded jointly with per-zone radial string lists

initialization.resolution: PDSP progressive removal plus deterministic spacing repair, then ten-rotation balanced Sweep with exact strings

update_order.resolution: selected-turbine 1-opt, nearby 2-opt fallback, feasible weighted shake, cable recomputation, strict feasible incumbent retention

wake_power_cost_or_coupled_model.resolution: T31-verified Jensen packed pair matrix plus official foundations, EPF 0.45 and capacity-priced visibility cable paths

wind_and_scenario_sampling.resolution: all 177 positive-probability official RVO_TNW direction-speed states and NREL 15 MW curve

paper_native_cases.resolution: ten official sites A-J crossed with published low and high density totals

parameters.resolution: EPF 0.45, 25 years, cable capacities/costs 4/240 and 6/336, ten Sweep rotations, 3D/5D/8D radii and frozen candidate caps

stopping_and_physical_fes.resolution: literal 10/24 h profiles exposed; formal uses 860 low and 2064 high complete VNS cycles

metrics_and_repeats.resolution: NPV, AEP/revenue, foundation, cable, feasibility, cycles, candidate/route work, timings and hashes over 25 seeds
